newsitem.title: CHINA: SKF unit, ASIMCO in $24 mln China venture.
newsitem.headline: SKF unit, ASIMCO in $24 mln China venture.

text.p: A U.S. subsidiary of SKF AB of Sweden and a unit of Asian Strategic Investments Corp (ASIMCO) have formed a $24 million joint venture to produce oil and sealing products in eastern China, ASIMCO said on Monday.
ASIMCO said the joint venture facilities would be at the existing site of its 60 percent-owned Anhui Ningguo Zhongding Automobile Components Co Ltd in Ningguo, Anhui province.
SKF's Chicago Rawhide unit has 60 percent of the venture and ASIMCO's Anhui Ningguo holds the remaining 40 percent. Output from the venture will be aimed at both the domestic and overseas markets.

ASIMCO is a Beijing-based direct investment company which has made use of capital from overseas. It has invested or committed funds of $350 million to 17 joint ventures in China. Many of the projects are focused on the automotive sector.
